title: Competition Fixed-Wing UAV

title: 3D Printing & Design for Manufacture
summary: Bambu Lab P1S with AMS plus heavily modified secondary printers. Ongoing work in tolerance tuning, print-oriented part design, and functional prototyping for the projects on this page.

title: FPV Drone Builds
summary: Building, tuning, and repairing FPV quads — frame and component selection, soldering and wiring, flight-controller tuning, and the failure analysis that follows every hard landing.

title: Custom PC Build
